notes.title: Doomwalker v0.4.0 update notes
notes.content:
Price Increase
$10 USD ----> $15 USD



This price increase reflects that amount of content added and improvements made to the game since the initial early access release in October 2024. The price will increase once more to the final release price of $20 USD when the game transitions from early access to normal release (TBA). 


[hr][/hr]

[hr][/hr]

New Level Cap
30 ---> 40






New Player Abilities (level 40)
Inferno (Fire) - Engulf everything nearby in a storm of flame, dealing massive damage over 6 seconds.



Void Tear (Shadow) - Rend the fabric of reality, causing a tear that seeks nearby enemies and deals damage to anything nearby every 0.25s for 5s.



Demon's Blood (Chaos) - Dash rapidly between nearby enemies, damaging them and triggering void instability each time a new target is hit.






New Companion Abilities (level 30)
Corrupt Essence (Dog) - Infuse an enemy with void energy, leeching health from the target and other nearby enemies to the player over 2s.



Bloodlust (Cat) - Rage and chaos consume your cat, causing it to furiously swipe nearby enemies dealing heavy damage over 2s.



Bgawwwk (Chicken) - Your chicken unleashes a primal bgawk, summoning an army of chicks that last 10s and seek out nearby foes and damage them.






New Zones
Kizuni Fen  (20-40) - A mist-shrouded swamp holding ancient secrets, and dangers, within...

Blackstone Pass (25-40) - A perilous mountain pass blackened by dragonsfire. Tread carefully...






New Enemies/Mobs and Bosses
Griffon

Spiders

Plants

Ents

Rats

Liches

Dragons






Total Quests
70 ----->  98



Total Equippable Items
34 -----> 45

notes.title: Doomwalker v0.3.3 and v0.3.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Please allow longer initial load times (1-2 minutes) when entering the main world! 

(for better performance in game)


[hr][/hr][hr][/hr]

v0.3.3 Patch Notes
This is a relatively small patch that updates the game engine from Unreal Engine 5.4 to 5.6 - offering more optimized loading/streaming processes, less stuttering than previous versions of Doomwalker, and a higher more consistent framerate while playing.



Swapping hotbar slots now works as intended (no longer makes one of your abilities vanish).



Added combat info section to the companion tab of the character page (default 'C' key).



New mobs:

Horses and Dragons!




[hr][/hr][hr][/hr]

v0.3.4 Patch Notes
This is effectively a pre-patch for 0.4.0, bringing stability and performance inprovements and updates to the world and zones being worked on for next patch: Blackstone Pass and Kizuni Fen.



You can finally unlock the area atop the spire in Deathfall Ruins... unlocking more of your full potential as the Doomwalker and providing more background to the history of world and the forces at work within...



More grass types in the world including snow and wheat!





New mobs:

Griffons




[hr][/hr]

[hr][/hr]

v0.4.0 will be releasing soon - notes to come 
I am trying to rush and get it out during the Summer Sale for you guys!



This will be a major content update with two brand new zones, tons of new quests, stories, loot and equipment, things to slay in glorious combat, and new developments to the main story!

notes.title: Doomwalker v0.3.1 and 0.3.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
v0.3.1 Notes

General

 The Howling Dens zone has been improved.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where you could use abilities while asleep, bugging out the player.
 Fixed critical issues with the player save/load process.
 Adjusted the collision on a few models for better gameplay.
 The pause menu no longer permanently blocks mouse click visibility after closing the menu.




--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
v0.3.2 Notes

General

 The Yorikuzo Heights and Moonless Woodlands Zones have been improved upon.
 The Character equipment page now has a new tab for your companion where you can select companion type, color, and see information (work in progress).
 Added Motion Blur toggle in the settings menu.
 Added Window mode option in the settings menu.
 Added more fast travel locations to the overworld.
 Elevators now have buttons to call it to your level (finally)!
 Fixed the collision of many meshes so that the player companion no longer passes through into the void.
 Exiting the Pause menu should now always resume the game.
 Reduced the performance impact of many light sources and overall overlap in the world.

notes.title: Doomwalker v0.3.0 is live!!!
notes.content:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
v0.3.0 Notes

Main World Revamp

The main world has been completely redesigned from the ground up implementing some new UE5 features that improve game experience and performance, allowing the creation of richer, larger worlds for you all to explore!

In-game performance should be drastically improved as a result of optimizing many core game systems. See more details about this in the v0.3.0 news announcement!

Link to v0.3.0 announcement post


A companion has joined your quest! 

You now have a companion that will assist you in combat.  This is a toggle in the settings menu (for type and enable/disable) if you wish to travel alone.



Redesigned HUD

The player HUD has been redesigned and now has a design that is very creative and new and never before seen in any game! :)



New Abilities and Talents

Much of the player attack system has been reworked, improving preformance, gameplay experience, and ensuring combat is as satisfying as possible to flood your brains with as much dopamine as possible.

The talent system has been improved and expanded upon, offering more variety and new skills and ability upgrades waiting to be unlocked...



New NPCs and Enemies

Lots of new NPC types have been added to the game including Deer, Pig, Chickens, Bears, Rabbits, and more! 

Additionally, enemy and NPC AI has been improved upon and should now feel more responsive and dynamic.


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
v0.3.1 Notes

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where you could use abilities while asleep, bugging out the player.
 Fixed an issue with the player save/load process.
 Adjusted the collision on a few models for better gameplay.
 The pause menu no longer permanently blocks mouse click visibility after closing the menu.



Content
Updated the Howling Dens subzone.

notes.title: Doomwalker v0.3 releases soon!!! (feat. mini-roadmap)
notes.content:
First of all, thank you to everyone who has played, purchased, or reviewed the game so far. This is my first large scale game as an indie developer and I sincerely appreciate all of you for your support!


-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

HUD Rework
The player HUD has been reoraganized and simplified.


-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Overworld Revamp
The overworld is being completely remade from the ground up utilizing the UE5 world-partition system, enabling much better performance!


-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Object Interfacing versus Casting
In earlier versions of the game, actors utilized what is called 'casting' to communicate with each other and do things in the world. If you are experienced with coding in UE5, you know what this means in terms of both game performance and the effort required to change and scale this up in a large game - the facepalm you just did is completely justified. Version 0.3 has fundamentally changed the way actors communicate with each other using interfaces instead.

TLDR: Game more good for PC memory and FPS


-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
New Content
Animals!
The world is finally getting more living creatures! 
These include: Birds, Pigs, Deer
(with more coming in future updates!)





-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Update Roadmap
(there will of course be small 0.0.x bug fixes between larger 0.x.0 versions for bug fixes or small content patches)


-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Version 0.3.0 - April 2025

(As stated above, and more!)


-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Version 0.4.0 - Q2 2025 (Price increase 10 USD ---> 15 USD)
As said in the initial early access release, this price increase reflects the amount of work put into the game since its initial release. Thank you to those that have supported the game since its early days! If Doomwalker is on your wishlist, I can promise that more awesome content is coming soon, consider getting it before this patch!


This patch will raise the level cap to 40, bring 2 new zones to the game, bring new unsettling developments to the main story culminating in Doomwalker's first raid: the Heart of Flame in update 0.5.0, and much more...


New Level Cap: 40

New Zones:
Kizuni Fen - Dark swamplands that hold an interesting secret deep within...
Blackstone Pass - A mountain pass that has been blackened by dragonsfire... tread carefully.


New Mobs:
Dragons, Foxes, Liches, (and more!)



-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Version 0.5.0 - Q3 2025
New Level Cap: 50

New Zone:
Solis Plateau - An expansive desert with an oasis and bustling town at its center, but beware... something lies beneath the sand... listening... 

New Raid:
Heart of Flame - An ancient being awakens deep within an active volcano, you will need more that your sword if you are to vanquish this foe...

New Mobs:
TBA

More info coming later!


-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

notes.title: Doomwalker v0.2.2 is now live!
notes.content:
New Boss

 In a new area, the Overgrown Hideout, a powerful foe has taken up residence. Defeating him will be challenging, but may grant a reward worthy of the effort...
 There is now a new main story cutscene for defeating Melandra in Decimus Arena...



New Achievements

 4 more achievements have been added for you to pursue! 



Quest System

 The quest log now shows more information about each quest, and has improved visual clarity.
 Abandoning quests now always works.
 Fixed an issue where questgivers would not update correctly if the quest was completed in a dungeon.



General

 Numerous adjustments have been made to models, lights, and foliage rendering that should noticeably increase game performace.
 Vines and foliage should no longer cause collision issues with the player camera.
 The player camera collision area has been reduced and now has smoother movement when looking around.
 Equipped items no longer appear in your inventory and can no longer be sold.
 Vendor UI's have been cleaned up.
 Many spell effects now have fewer, but more visually impactful particles and effects.
 The rate between many enemies ranged attack casts have been increased.

notes.title: Doomwalker Early Access v0.2.0 and v0.2.1 update notes
notes.content:
Due to massive changes in gameplay, world design, and user experience, it is highly recommended that you delete your save file and start a new game if you have already downloaded and played the game prior to the release of v0.2.0.



General

 Level Cap: 30
 The world now has cliffs and more diverse foliage!
 Enemy AI has been improved.
 General in-game performance has been massively improved.
 Many abilities that enemies can cast have been reworked.
 Unlocking a new fast travel location now has an updated visual.
 Added an adjustable FOV slider to the settings menu.
 Added an "Unstuck" button to the help menu.
 Added new tabs to the Help menu: Equipment, Currency, Talents
 Most of the player UI has been completely redesigned and updated for visual clarity (still WIP).
 Fixed an issue where the wrong quests were unlocking after turning in a quest.
 Fixed an issue that caused certain bosses to be treated as normal enemies.
 All in-game music has been upgraded, enjoy.
 Fixed an issue where sometimes the player questlog and hotbar would not save/load properly.
 Fixed an issue where the audio was not changing correctly upon entering or leaving dungeons.


Improved Tutorial Experience

 The new game tutorial experience is now more in-depth, and introduces the player to boss combat and the in-game menus.


Ability Reworks

 Kiriotoshi 
OLD: 3x damage to a single target.
NEW: 2x and cause shadow energy to explode for 1x damage to all nearby enemies after 1 second.


New Zones
 
 Forgotten Grove (Tutorial)
 Decimus Arena has been redesigned.


Gatherables

 There are now gatherable items to collect in the world!
 Be on the lookout for items on the ground, they might lead you to powerful treasure...


Quests

 Tons of new quests have been added to the world! (46 --> 67)
 Most existing questlines have been expanded upon or have been reworked.

notes.title: Doomwaler Early Access v0.1.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed some audio events that were incorrectly triggering on/off, or would cut off halfway through.
 Some enemy spawners were not working (not spawning enemies), they should now be fixed.
 Adjusted the location of the questgiver icon for certain characters.
 Fixed an issue where the UI was not refreshing upon selecting and removing talent points.
 Fixed an issue where the quest log was visible even when you had no quests.
 Ambient music now fades out while in boss combat instead of playing alongside boss music.
 The drawing order of the player UI has been reorganized to fix issues where panels were not allowing anything drawn beneath to be interacted with (hovered/clicked).



General

 Adjusted player level-up experience scaling.
 More quests now have a loot reward!
 Slightly lowered the player character mesh position.
 Slightly increased character sprint speed and slightly reduced run speed.
 Reduced the time delay before respawning by 50%.
 Fixed an issue where the quest log was visible even when you had no quests.
 Signposts finally give information about where things are in the world!
 Leveling up now knockbacks nearby foes and has an updated visual!
 Improved tooltips!
 Improved fast travel menu!


Steam Achievements

 You can now pursue 5 achievements that have been added to the game (with many more to come)!

notes.title: Doomwalker v0.1.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Bug Fixes  

 Fixed an issue where boss music was not fading out upon respawn, causing an infinite loop of glorious melody.



General

 Enemy Info bars are now visible from further away to give players more time to see them before entering combat.
 Friendly characters now have more diverse dialogue options.
 Quick Heal no longer goes on cooldown if used at max health.
 A mysterious fog has appeared in the Whispering Depths dungeon...
 In addition to pressing W, you can now move the player forward by holding down both mouse buttons at the same time.



Settings Page Improvements

 Added a Vsync toggle option.
 Added game setting options for textures.
 Added an option to toggle in-game speech bubbles.
 The 'Quit' button now takes you back to the main menu instead of exiting the game.



Help Page Improvements

 Added a Controls tab where players can view the game controls.
 Added a Questing tab.
 Added a Dungeons tab.
 Added a Rituals tab.

notes.title: Doomwalker v0.1.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Doomwalker Early Access v0.1.1 Patch Notes

Shadows

 Directional lights in the overworld should now produce smoother shadows.
 Shadows should now flicker less often when viewed from a long distance.
 Some foliage lightmaps have been altered to increase shadow resolution.
 Shadows are now darker.



Lights

 Fixed an issue where some lights and niagara effects did not cull at large distances from the player, resulting in performance losses.
 Increased fog density in the overworld.
 Sky Lighting now works differently in the overworld.



World Objects

 Fixed an issue with the collision on some world items that caused them to fall through the floor and be lost to the ether.



Audio

 Fixed several audio cues which were not scaling properly with the volume sliders.



Main Menu

 Added game version to bottom-right screen.



Enemy Adjustments

 Bandit Brawler - Health increased by 10%, Damage decreased by 10%
 Bandit Strategist - Damage decreased by 10%
 Bandit Taskmaster - Health increased by 10%
 Kizuni Watcher - Health increase by 15%
 Chattering Ghoul - Health increased by 20%
 Lost Soul - Health increased by 10%, Damage Increased by 5%
 Pustulent Horror - Health Increased by 10%



As always, if you encounter bugs, performance issues, or have quality-of-life ideas, please post them in the Steam discussion section!
